newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asia Amalgamated seeks nod for rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Asia Amalgamated seeks nod for rights offer.

text.p: Asia Amalgamated Holdings Corp said on Thursday it is submitting its registration statement to the Securities and Exchange Commission for a stocks right offering for 60 billion shares.
Asia Amalgamated said in an advisory the issue value will be one centavo per share or a total offering of 600 million pesos.
The company is increasing its authorized capital stock from 200 million to 800 million pesos. Details of the offer will be announced later, the statement said.
Asia Amalgamated is the financial services company of the Gow family, majority owner of Uniwide Holdings Inc.
